Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

There is no visible crack or liquid damage, and the carrying case, USB cable, and quick-start card are all still with me.

At the desk on Tuesday, a staff member looked at the loan record and said, “We can check the battery pack, but we cannot promise a replacement until the equipment room is open.” I understand that the library may not be able to decide right away. The equipment room is scheduled to open on Thursday, June 5, according to the hours posted at the desk. My request is conditional on what the equipment team can confirm by that date, rather than on the scanner simply being checked in at the desk.

If they cannot replace it by then, please do not renew the current scanner; instead, please place a hold for me on another ScanMate V4 at East Branch for pickup on Friday, June 6, and leave the current scanner’s June 8 return date unchanged. Those are the two arrangements i am asking about, and the second one is not a request to extend the existing loan while i wait for a different unit.

For reference, the work is a small neighborhood history project, not a library event or a commercial job. I am scanning about 140 pages from a set of family newsletters and meeting notes that belong to the Northgate Garden Club. The paper is a mixture of letter-size sheets and a few folded pages, and i have been using the scanner’s normal color setting at 300 dpi. I can do the remaining pages in two sessions, but i need the scanner for an appointment at the community archive on Saturday, June 7, when a volunteer will compare my digital copies with the club’s originals. I can change that appointment if necessary, but i need to know which scanner arrangement is possible before i confirm it.

1. The asset number on my receipt is SC-214, and it matches the label on the scanner. The loan currently lists one ScanMate V4, one AC charger, one USB cable, one carrying case, and one quick-start card. I have checked those items against the receipt, and none are missing. The scanner has no visible damage beyond the battery losing charge quickly. I do not need an explanation of the repair process; i need confirmation that the unit will be usable for the June 7 archive appointment. 4. If a replacement battery is installed in SC-214, please tell me whether the equipment team tested it under use, not only whether the charger light came on. If a different ScanMate V4 is reserved, please confirm that the charger and USB cable are included with that loan. I do not need the club’s papers stored or handled by the library; i will bring only the scanner kit for the inspection or pickup.
